ideas.note: Ordered for review, not a prediction. This ordering has not been tested yet.
ideas.rule: declared: filed in the last 3 sessions; upcoming: meeting on the date or in the next 5 sessions; the OI part reads total futures OI across every expiry; in the 5 sessions up to and including a monthly expiry, short covering and long unwinding score as no clear signal (expiry week: open interest falls as contracts close); All list has no OI part (its weight spread pro rata); Chartink hits are shown, never scored; ties: higher earnings score, then symbol

expectations.source: DaaS /desk/events-calendar/expectations (universe all, windows of at most 3 days)
expectations.label: A baseline from the company's own published quarters, not an analyst consensus and not a forecast.
expectations.method: Same quarter last year × recent growth
expectations.formula: expected = value of the same quarter a year earlier × (1 + average of the last two year-on-year growth rates); band = 10th–90th percentile of this method's own past errors across all stocks, for stocks with similar growth stability

filing_analysis.source: Mongo event_ai_analysis (event_type containing RESULT; single_full / *_compact; tools off, isolated)
filing_analysis.label: filing analysis, not a guidance tracker

history.source: DaaS /desk/events-calendar/history (type RESULTS): the stock's own close on past results days and the next session; past behaviour, not a forecast

prices.reaction_basis: first session after the filing (filed at or after 15:30 IST → the next session), close to close, minus Nifty 50's return the same session; volume × vs the mean of up to 20 earlier sessions

fno_buildup.source: NSE F&O bhavcopy via DaaS: /desk/fno-buildup (total OI over every expiry, cash close) and /fno/{symbol} (futures of every expiry, one options expiry)
fno_buildup.headline: total futures OI across every expiry vs the spot, last session
fno_buildup.rollover: read in the 5 sessions before a monthly expiry, against the stock's last 5 expiries at the same distance
fno_buildup.options: the first expiry more than 7 days after the date; open interest cannot tell buyers from writers

technicals.source: app Postgres stock_technical_features (AI scanner, nightly 19:45 IST; price-only)
